status: Frozen before acquisition and outcome analysis of external features. Exploratory retrospective expansion: same historical NEAR test period has already been inspected in earlier experiments. Not independent prospective validation.
sector_limits: Fixed equal-weight research proxies, excluding NEAR/BTC/ETH. Not exhaustive indices or historical point-in-time category membership. Current survivors and prior-selected SUI/APT/SEI introduce selection bias. Do not replace members based on test performance. Missing required member excludes the timestamp, not silently renormalizes.
inputs: Bybit linear sector candles, Binance NEARUSDT spot15min taker-buy and total quote volume, Bybit1h account-ratio, previously probed Near chain stablecoin/TVL/DEX daily histories. Preserve source hashes and receive times. No paid bridge/flow data claimed.
features: Base19price+5derivatives plus causal current-close distance to prior4h stop. Sector: equal-weight1h/4h returns,1h breadth, turnover breadth, prior30d BTC-beta-adjusted1h return, NEAR4h excess vs basket. Spot: normalized signed quote volume15m/1h/4h,4h delta acceleration,1h turnover build, spot-futures basis,1h price excess, spot share of two venue volumes. Chain: stablecoin face-unit changes1/7d,7d/previous28d DEX volume,TVL7d change (not net inflow). Account: long-holder fraction, change1/4h. Fixed feature groups; no tuning after results.
availability: Use closed candles. Ratio timestamp+1h with2h maximum staleness. Daily records timestamp+48h primary,24h sensitivity; actual historical publication/revision times unknown. Daily index reindexed before differences, no backfill. sector BTC beta uses prior rolling30d, shifted1bar. No price-based USD TVL increase labeled cash inflow.
candidate: Same hourly quiet candidates as near_deep: abs1h return<1%, abs4h return<2%. All variants use identical complete rows including24/48h chain variants and valid positive current-close stop distance. Gapped next-open stop invalidation is execution cancellation, explicitly counted; no outcome-dependent selection otherwise.
primary_outcome: Target first BEFORE fixed initial prior4h low for long/high for short; entry next15min open proxy. Same-bar target/stop counts stop. Stop gaps fill at worse open. Timeout is negative for target-before-stop. No leverage or liquidation modeled.
sensitivity_scope: Models trained for4h stop; apply identical frozen alerts to all4 stop definitions without selecting best policy. Every alternative explicitly a sensitivity, not separately optimized model. Report rejected stops and coverage.
models: StandardScaler+LogisticRegression C1,max_iter2000; HistGradientBoosting max_iter100,max_leaf_nodes7,learning_rate.05,l2_regularization1,early_stoppingFalse,random_state17. Same complexity for every group; no hyperparameter search.
splits: Reuse3chronological90day tests; each preceding90day calibration and360day training,73h label purge,72h embargo. Choose threshold among calibration score quantiles80/90/95/97.5/99%,6h cooldown,>=20calibration alerts, maximize exact95precision lower bound. Serialize model/threshold before test scoring.
comparison: Compare alerts, target-before-stop precision, weekly95CI, after20bp cost mean, pre-onset recall, all-candidate Brier/AUC. Paired weekly external-minus-baseline Brier improvement with9999week-sign permutations and Holm across all112added-group comparisons, plus paired weekly bootstrap. Baseline price/OI model retrained on same new target/rows; prior target-touch results are not comparable performance gains.
controls: Same quiet pool scheduled6h baseline; same-week random timing at matched alert count for exploratory diagnostic, not uniform causal inference. Compare per-fold and BTC regime; report every group. No claim that more features causes higher precision.
deployment: No model promotion or Slack signal changes from this research.80% claim requires future frozen test,>=100alerts,>=8weeks,>=10%onset recall and weekly95lower>=80%. Historical external features with publication/revision and membership gaps cannot establish this.
